question_text: How many detections had low confidence today, say below 85%?
answer_text: There were 30,467 detections with a confidence level below 85% today. Throughout the day, CCTV activity included a high volume of person entries and exits, as well as car movements, across various time slots and camera locations. These activities contribute to the significant number of low-confidence detections, potentially influenced by various environmental and technical factors throughout the day.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND e.confidence < 0.85
  RETURN count(e) AS n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ce:CrowdEvent)
  WHERE ce.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ce.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND ce.confidence < 0.85
  RETURN count(ce) AS n
}
RETURN sum(n) AS low_confidence_detections
